image_description: A close-up photograph of an ornate, handcrafted necklace displayed on a black velvet-like surface. The necklace features large, irregular amber or resin segments with embedded floral or organic patterns, connected by gold-tone wire wrapping and small green beads. It forms a circular loop typical of a choker or short necklace style.
